summary: Sub-Phase E1 — Predict & Win admin builder backend acceptance. critical_code_review_comments: predict_win_admin.py is 1,166 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into: schemas.py (Pydantic models), guards.py (lexicon + event-type guards), bootstrap.py (ensure_indexes + seed_manual_provider), and route modules per resource (campaigns/prizes/compliance/resolutions). Easier to test and review.

Create response shape is {ok:true, campaign:{...}}. Other admin routers in this codebase return the resource object directly; consider normalising to one of the two patterns app-wide for client predictability.

Adviser/seed log noise: `[adv_seed] index creation: ... E11000 duplicate key error ... id: null` keeps spamming on every boot. Unrelated to E1 but adds log noise that hides real errors during E1 debugging.
